home.q: Is the directory free to use?
home.a: Yes. Searching, filtering, comparing and reading guides is free. You only pay if you choose the Assist matching service.

home.q: How do you decide the order of providers?
home.a: Default order is by profile completeness and verified data. Paid placements are always labelled. The full method is on the How we rank page.
[OWNERSHIP STATEMENT, to be confirmed before launch].

home.q: Can you guarantee a merchant account?
home.a: No. Approval is always the provider's decision. We help you reach providers that fit your profile.

category.q: What does a card processing provider do?
category.a: It connects your checkout to the card networks, authorises transactions and settles funds to your account, either directly or through an acquiring bank.

category.q: How do I compare card processing fees?
category.a: Ask every provider for the same pricing model, usually interchange plus or blended, and compare on your real ticket size and card mix rather than headline rates.

category.q: Which providers accept higher risk merchants?
category.a: Use the Industry filter on this page. Profiles list the industries each provider says it supports.

compare.q: Which is better, Provider Alpha or Provider Beta?
compare.a: It depends on where you sell. Provider Alpha covers more countries; Provider Beta has deeper local method support in Brazil.

compare.q: Can I use both providers at once?
compare.a: Yes, many merchants route by country or method through an orchestration layer.

assist.a: A short intro call, a written brief about your business, then introductions to providers that fit. You talk to them directly.

assist.q: Do you take a commission from providers?

providers.a: Yes. The free profile includes your description, services, coverage and a verified badge once we confirm your details.

providers.q: How do you verify a company?
providers.a: We check company registration, licences where relevant and a working contact at the company domain.

providers.q: Can I pay to rank higher?
providers.a: Featured placements exist and are always labelled as such. They never change the default order.
